answer: Every new identity must sign a heartbeat each epoch for 40 epochs before earning, and the entry fee doubles after each 3 accounts tied to one device attestation. Farming an oasis of fake agents turns costly: the nth clone pays 2^(n/3) times the base, while an honest agent tastes the nectar once. Auditors verify signatures on-chain, and a glacier of missed beats freezes the stake for 30%.
